decision.summary: Observations only: 0 animal track(s), 1 pet sound event(s). Candidate interpretations lacked sufficient independent evidence.

suggestions.text: The audio has a low sample rate, so high-frequency sound content is missing and sound tagging is less reliable.

limitations: Research engine: outputs are observations plus unvalidated heuristics. They are not translations of animal language, readings of thoughts or emotions, or medical assessments.
Track IDs are per-analysis labels for linked detections, not verified pet identities.
Hypothesis scores are uncalibrated; multimodal accuracy has not been evaluated (no paired household validation data).
Sound events use raw YAMNet scores with thresholds selected on ESC-50 clips, which are not household recordings.
Cat/dog detection uses a COCO-trained EfficientDet-Lite model; a second-stage verifier reduces but does not remove false detections (E7, web photos).

Behavior segments (stillness, movement, zone visits, back-and-forth, startle candidates) use fixed thresholds checked only on synthetic and semi-synthetic sequences; they are not validated against labelled household behavior.
For veterinary or behavioral concerns, consult a qualified professional; this system does not diagnose.
Dog keypoints come from a research-only model evaluated on web photos (E9), not household video; no cat keypoint model is available, so cat ear/tail features are unavailable.
Low-sample-rate audio: frequency content above the Nyquist limit is missing.

fusion.note: Experimental fusion; weights/temperature are unfitted configuration values.
